name: Wrenfield County Firefighters, Local 2217
role: Union of county and volunteer firefighters
quote: Noor walked every posted bridge with us and asked which ones we can't send an engine over. Then she wrote them down.

name: Dolores Pike
quote: She answered my question about the health office on my porch, then sent me the budget page that night.

name: The Wrenfield Ledger editorial board
quote: The most specific plan we have seen from a commission candidate in a decade, with costs attached.

name: Hon. Arturo Velez
quote: Noor knows the difference between a promise and a schedule. Her plan has schedules.

name: Wren Valley Dairy Cooperative
quote: Our trucks have been going around the Pell Orchard bridge for five years. She is the first candidate to put it at the top of a list.

name: Marisol Teague
quote: She read the flood study contract before she knocked on my door.

name: Wrenfield Child Care Directors Network
quote: The zoning changes in her plan are the ones we have been asking for since 2018.

name: Hon. Bea Lindqvist
quote: Posting the checkbook monthly is easy. I know, because I could have done it. Noor will.

name: Hollin Cross Grange No. 412
quote: Evening meetings would mean farmers could finally come.

name: Gus Ambler
quote: Eleven minutes each way, twice a day, for five years. She timed it with me.
